audience: developers and admins who manage users, organizations and roles in Kinde

useCases.title: Find a user and their organizations
useCases.text: The AI lists users, narrowed by email or user id, and opens one user with their organizations and identities.

useCases.title: Check what a person can do in an organization
useCases.text: The AI reads the roles and the permissions one user holds in one organization. You get a direct answer to what this person can do there.

useCases.title: Review roles and their permissions
useCases.text: The AI lists the roles and permissions of the business, and the permissions attached to each role. It can point out roles that look too broad.

useCases.title: Check which feature flags are set
useCases.text: The AI lists the feature flags with their values at the environment level, and the overrides set for one organization.

useCases.title: Create an organization and add users
useCases.text: The AI creates a new organization and adds existing users to it, optionally with roles and permissions.

useCases.title: Create a role or permission and grant it to a user
useCases.text: The AI creates a role or a permission, then gives a user that role or permission within one organization.
